original_metadata.title: Every connected orbit-type piece of an arbitrary-level Hamiltonian generalized complex quotient by a compact Lie group inherits a natural untwisted generalized complex structure
original_metadata.author: Timothy E. Goldberg
original_metadata.source_title: Singular Reduction of Generalized Complex Manifolds
original_metadata.difficulty_reason: Free generalized complex reduction does not directly apply to singular orbit-type pieces, and the ambient moment map need not have a regular value. The author proves that fixed loci are split generalized complex submanifolds, constructs the normalizer quotient action on the relevant components, and shows the restricted moment map descends with the required Hamiltonian conditions. A shifting construction handles nonzero coadjoint levels, while the untwisted case removes ambient compactness by a separate moment-map argument.

proof_review.note: Read complete untwisted generalized complex and split-submanifold definitions2-6; full Haar-averaging fixed-locus Proposition2.19 on6-7; exact orbit-type/normalizer facts8-9; Hamiltonian moment condition10, full restriction proof Theorem4.5 on10-11 and stated prior Lin-Tolman free reduction4.6; complete shifting map/coadjoint-orbit construction12-13; and full singular normalizer construction plus untwisted compactness-removal argument14-16. Select Theorem5.3(a) only for untwisted GC M and compact Lie group G, equivariant real generalized moment map, arbitrary a in g-star and each connected orbit-type piece. M is not required compact; the authored final paragraph derives dmu^xi=0 directly on K-fixed pieces, so the selected branch does not depend on the omitted generalized maximum-principle argument Lemma5.2 for twisted manifolds. Prior split-submanifold integrability and Lin-Tolman free reduction are precisely stated published foundations, while the local new fixed/normalizer/restriction/shift cores are supplied. Do not claim a Whitney stratification, global singular GC structure or compatibility between pieces; twisted5.3(b) and generalized Kahler corollary are uncounted same-core extensions. Exact selected statement and terminal proof pages rendered and visually inspected; physical headers/native ZIP members and source/license hashes checked. No independent mathematical reproof.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Theorem5.3(a): M is an untwisted generalized complex manifold, G a compact Lie group acting canonically and in the original Lin-Tolman Hamiltonian sense with smooth G-equivariant moment map mu:M->g-star satisfying xi_M=-J(dmu^xi). For arbitrary a in g-star, each connected component of (mu^{-1}(O_a) intersect M_(K))/G inherits a natural untwisted generalized complex structure from M. No compactness of M, regular value or freeness is imposed globally. No twisted/moment-one-form extension, generalized Kahler extension, Whitney stratification or global structure on the whole singular quotient.
original_metadata.source_boundary_note: The complete original Theorem5.3 is retained, with selected scope restricted to part(a), untwisted singular generalized reduction without ambient compactness. The shared proof includes all fixed-locus splitting, Hamiltonian restriction, normalizer-quotient action, exact descended moment map, orbit-type comparison, coadjoint shifting construction and the separate noncompact untwisted closure. Prior Lin-Tolman free reduction and standard compact-group orbit-type facts remain cited formulations. The original part(b) and shared twisted proof provide uncounted context; no generalized Kahler or global singular-space structure is separately selected.
